compensation_details: Study participation $15/hour; RA arrangements via faculty

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Rolling

description:
The Wharton Behavioral Lab provides staff, technology, and lab space supporting faculty and student research on how people think, act, and make decisions, recruiting participants and running behavioral experiments. For undergraduates it is both a gateway into behavioral research operations (experiment support and RA exposure via faculty projects) and a paid participant pool — study sessions pay $15/hour. Wharton students doing SPUR/SIRE projects run studies through the lab, which holds monthly open office hours for researchers.
